name: Vampiric Seduction
source:
Vampiric Seduction is an adult pixel-art fantasy game that focuses on a story about a vampire coming back to life and trying to regain his status, while also bedding plenty of women along the way. The story follows the protagonist as he begins to find his place in the world and use his formidable powers to win over the people he desires.

[From [url=https://vespertilio98.itch.io/vampiricseduction]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Vampiric Seduction》是一款成人像素风奇幻游戏，讲述了一名复活的吸血鬼试图重夺昔日地位，并在旅途中与众多女性共赴巫山的故事。剧情围绕主人公展开，描绘他逐步在世间找回立足之地，并运用强大的力量征服心仪对象的过程。

[引自[url=https://vespertilio98.itch.io/vampiricseduction]Itch.io[/url]]
